A green silk skirt lined with a red cotton and a red cotton waist band with tie. The green silk is embellished with metal sequins with clear glass beads above a row of mirrors set in gold repoussé frames and a band of woven metal thread. At the bottom there is a wide band of orange cotton with red and green velvet appliqué, mirrors in gold frames and metal sequins with clear glass beads. There is a stiff canvas sewn in between the bottom band and the lining.

An over skirt made from thin, loosely woven cotton with stripes of metal thread woven through, a red cotton waistband and an embellished hem. The hem is made of a band of red cotton with a trim of black velvet along the top, green silk along with bottom and metallic gold in the centre; the black and green trims are embellished with metal sequins and clear glass beads; the gold band is embellished with round mirrors set in gold repoussé metal frames and metal sequins and clear glass beads; the bottom edge of the hem is lined with silver glass beads and metal sequins.

Jacket made of velvet and cotton, decorated with metal embellishments. Upper body of dark red velvet lined with purple woven cloth; lower body of unlined white calico or linen; short sleeves decorated with mirrors, sequins, metal sunburst motifs and glass beads on a background of woven purple, pink and metallic threads; sleeves and collar trimmed with green; five metal snap fasteners along front opening.

T-shaped belt. Waist band of red felt with central, woven gold band decorated with central row of circular mirrors, with gold-coloured metal serrated surrounds, sewn with white cotton and rows of silver-coloured sequins with small metal spirals at centre. Wide sash of red felt with two rows of mirrors and same decoration as waist band. Trapezoid sash base with two diamond-shaped, serrated mirrors; rows of vertical, thin, gold wrapped tubes, with green velvet top and bottom and central band of red felt decorated with metal sequins; twisted silver thread tassels at base and metal trim on sides. Reverse lined with red cotton and green silk, stitched on with black and white cotton.

Necklace with gold filigree pendants and wooden beads. Central section consists of 20 filigree pendants made from a wire-wrapped core with decoration of wire and granulation; pendants alternate with two faceted beads with wire and granulation; section at either end of the necklace has alternating wooden beads and knots; strung on brown silk or cotton cord with a metal spring ring fastening. Three wooden beads missing.

Necklace with golden pointed ovoid pendants. 14 filled pendants with a horizontal pointed ovoid form hanging from two loops; pendants alternate with groups of seven or eight faceted brass beads with a gilded surface; fastened with a loop of cord and a faceted bead. Strung on cotton cord.

Strung on white cotton cord.

Bracelet with ovoid pendants, made from brass with possible gilding. Eight pendants with a horizontal ovoid form hanging from a faceted ring; at the centre is one pointed ovoid pendant with incised decoration around the top, hanging from a faceted ring; each pendant alternates with three faceted beads. Earring or pendant made from gilded brass. A pair of dangling ornaments connected by a length of wire; both ornaments are composed of three metal discs hanging below one another with a fringe of rectangular pendants around the edge of each.
